maria_cs: Quick reserved-capacity check-in for ACME — dropping a short snapshot, please ack and flag anything unusual.

maria_cs: Metrics snapshot (past 7d):
```
GPU hours: 3,720 (W/W -12%)
Saturation: 78% avg (peak 92% Tue 14:00 UTC)
Avg queue depth: 9.2 (spike to 23 at Tue 13:45)
99p latency: 620ms (target 500ms)
Errors (5xx): 42 (increase after canary)
Spend vs commit: +18%
```

noah_ops: ack, saw the queue spike in the same window. starting log dig.

jay_infra: fyi I rolled a small model variant canary Tue 12:30 — correlates w/ spike. I can throttle the canary for now.

tanya_customer: ACME reported timeouts ~13:30-14:10, they attached traces in the support ticket.

maria_cs: action items: (1) noah confirm root cause by EOD; (2) jay propose throttle or rollback plan; (3) I'll prep a short note for ACME and add to renewal risk tracker. tagging @deploy-bot for rollback guardrails.

jay_infra: suggested throttle command: `redwoodctl scale pool acme-reserved --max-inflight 80` — will test on staging. if OOMs persist we should roll back variant.

noah_ops: tailing logs now, early sign is KV cache pressure causing mem growth on pool-4, causing pod restarts. snippet: ```ERROR: kv_cache_alloc failed: alloc=1.2Gi limit=1.0Gi```

deploy-bot: Canary rollback trigger armed: errors_threshold=50 window=3600s. Will post if threshold breached.

maria_cs: good. I'll update ACME: short note + ask them to hold heavy batch jobs for the next 2 hours. also flagging spend drift for finance sync.

tanya_customer: I'll prepare a usage break-down + suggested batching/quantization playbook before Friday renewal review.

jay_infra: opening ticket CS-7891 for pod diagnostics and autoscaler tuning, adding logs and proposed config change.

maria_cs: thanks all — please post EOD summary in this thread. I'll escalate if root cause isn't confirmed by 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
